verdicts.reason: Both have the same layout problems. The SOLSTICE wordmark now sits below the headline, so the reading order is wrong. A large empty band separates the copy from the centred CTA, which doesn't share an axis with the left-aligned text. The flavour pills are crammed into the top-left over the decorative circle and listed in a different order from the original. A is worse: its pills are inconsistent (HONEY ROSEMARY has larger type than the others, and BLOOD ORANGE nearly touches the pill above it), and its headline runs almost to the right edge with a tight 32px margin. B keeps the pill sizes and type consistent and gives the headline more even margins, though its BLOOD ORANGE pill sits slightly out of line with the row above.
